description: Trace one Circle CCTP V2 USDC transfer between Base and Ethereum from its SOURCE transaction, on demand (pilot since 2026-11-23; nothing stored, no history index). For every CCTP message in the transaction (a transaction can carry several; each is keyed by its CCTP nonce, or its source log before Circle assigns one): the burn in native units with decimals, messageSender, mintRecipient and destination domain (CCTP domains: Ethereum 0, Base 6; not chain ids), Circle’s attestation state from Iris v2, the destination MessageReceived and mint checked against the nonce, minted amount, fee executed, timings, and a status the protocol evidences: source_observed, attested, destination_pending, completed or unknown. A missing mint is pending, never lost. Then `subsequent`: deposits by the mint recipient into vaults we track within `hours` after the mint, each labelled a possible subsequent deposit (same address, later), not proven same coins. Never claims the addresses share an owner, that an AI agent acted, or that anything was autonomous. bridge_coverage says what is and is not covered. FREE.

hours.description: Window after the mint for possible subsequent deposits: default 72, at most 168.

network.description: The SOURCE network, where the burn happened.

name: cross_chain_trace

coverage.description: The pilot’s coverage, as bridge_coverage states it.

index.description: The stored index: state (read | not_yet_read | unavailable), readAt, says.

messages.description: One entry per CCTP V2 message: key, keyKind, kind, status, statusSays, source, burn, messageSender, mintRecipient, messageRecipient, destinationCaller, destinationDomain, destinationNetwork, inScope, attestation (state, nonce, finality, delayReason), feeExecuted, expirationBlock, destination (state, evidence, tx, minted, feeCollected, checks), timings, subsequent (state, windowHours, deposits with label). Empty when the transaction carries none.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

notClaimed.description: What this trace never establishes: same owner, an AI agent, autonomy, same coins.

says.description: One sentence on what was found.

servedFrom.description: Since 2026-11-24: index when every message of the transaction is held in the stored index and completed; on_demand when it was read now.

sourceReceipt.description: What the source chain said about the transaction; unread is no provider answered, never absent.

volume.description: USDC burned, counted once per transfer (amount native, decimals, amountFormatted); the mint is a phase of the same transfer, never added.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

title: Cross-chain trace (CCTP V2 pilot)
